dedupe_keys.name: uk caa departing passenger survey bespoke data subsets

description: The Departing Passenger Survey of the UK Civil Aviation Authority interviews passengers departing from UK airports to build a picture of how they use airports and air services. Beyond the published survey reports, the CAA sells bespoke subsets of the interview records. Fields cover network development (origin, interline and destination airports, all airlines and flight numbers), UK home and origin down to district and post sector, ticket type, class and cost, demographics (country of residence, nationality, age, sex, income and socio-economic group), journey purpose, surface access mode with up to three connecting modes, journey time and group size, and marketing questions such as reasons for choosing the airport; several fields stopped after 2019 when the questionnaire was rescoped following the pandemic. Coverage: surveyed UK airports, annual. Access: request by email; charges are 5.9 pence per core field, 4.5 pence per calculated field and 2.4 pence per non-core field per record, a minimum variable charge of 275 pounds plus a fixed 115 pounds plus VAT, so extracts start at 390 pounds. Licence and cost: paid, terms agreed per request. Caveats: sampled survey with weighting (methodology pages provided), not all airports every year, and some fields discontinued. It supports agent-based and network flow models of air passenger demand and airport surface access. It complements the CAA airport statistics and DfT aviation statistics in the catalogue.
